rule: Each NPC's attitude to the player comes from a signed reaction per faction pair. If the NPC's own faction is one the player belongs to and has not been expelled from, use that faction's reaction to itself; otherwise scan the player's non-expelled factions and take the smallest reaction, with the rank of that faction. The attitude term is the reaction times a rank-based multiplier and a personality term, added to disposition. Runtime overrides are stored per faction pair and win over the record's own table.
keep: A signed reaction per faction pair, so one rival can be liked by one group and disliked by another with no extra rule.
Worst standing among the player's non-expelled factions decides the attitude.
Expulsion removes a faction from the count.
Runtime overrides per pair win over the base table.
